text:
lina: quick review please — i'm iterating on compact sidebar pin UX + breadcrumbs behavior. sketched flows here: https://figma.com/proto/compact-pin (screens 1-4). main goals: make deep links stable, avoid surprise scroll jumps, and keep keyboard nav predictable. thoughts?
matt: looks good, one thing — when a section is pinned do we collapse other sections or keep them as-is?
lina: thinking keep-as-is (non-destructive). pin should just freeze that group open, not hide others. users still need context.
jay: +1 for keep-as-is. for routing: deep links to sub-items should preserve pinned state in the URL so we can restore callers. maybe query param ?pin=teams-42?
anika: accessibility nit — if we add pin state in URL we must ensure screen readers get an aria-live announcement when a pin is toggled and when breadcrumb focus moves. also keyboard: Space/Enter to toggle pin, mdn pattern for aria-pressed could work.
rob: technically storing pin in query param is fine, but beware of link sharing. if someone copies URL with ?pin= we might accidentally pin for other users. maybe we namespace it to session or add pin=volatile?
lina: good point. alternative: use history state (pushState) for ephemeral pins, and use fragment/hash for stable deep anchors. e.g. /workspace/abc/nav#teams/42?openPin=1 is messy though.
matt: simpler: use pushState to reflect current open group (no query) and maintain permanent deep links via path segments: /w/abc/nav/teams/42. Pin state = ephemeral UI state stored in history only. that avoids sharing.
jay: i like that. pinned UI state is local-only. but we still want an explicit "pin" UX when copying link — maybe a small ctrl+click "copy view link (with pin)" option in the menu.
anika: copy wording: avoid ambiguous verbs. prefer "Pin section" for button tooltip and "Keep section open" for longer helper text. when copying include a confirmation toast: "Link copied — includes pinned sections". also ensure focus remains on the pin button after action.
rob: implementation note: keyboard focus needs tabindex=0 on group headers, aria-expanded on toggles, aria-controls referencing the group list. We'll add a small ID pattern: navgrp-<id>-list.
matt: about breadcrumbs — if the left rail has collapsed groups, breadcrumb should show the full path (Workspace > Teams > Team Name) and be keyboard focusable. Breadcrumb links should use the same path segments we agreed on.
lina: decision proposal: 1) keep pin as local history state (pushState), 2) deep links = path segments, 3) offer explicit "copy view" that includes pin flag, 4) aria live announce on pin toggle and breadcrumb navigation, 5) label changes: use "Pin section" + helper text. 6) no auto-collapse of other groups when pinning.
jay: +1 from product.
anika: +1 from accessibility, but please add a11y test case for screen reader and keyboard-only flows.
matt: i'll prototype the pushState + breadcrumb linkage. will post a small patch with code example:
```
// pseudo pushState
const state = { openGroup: 'teams-42', pinned: true }
history.replaceState(state, '', `/w/${ws}/nav/teams/42`)
```
rob: sounds good. one more engineering ask: bump focus trap timeout when animating expand/collapse to avoid focus loss on long lists.
lina: noted. i'll update the figma and the copy doc. next steps: matt to prototype, anika to add a11y checklist, rob to review DOM ids. i'll create a tiny PR checklist in the thread.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: design-prototype → staging at 2024-11-03T09:00Z :white_check_mark:
matt: thanks all — i'll ping when prototype is live :eyes:
